title: Brands in the catalogue API and shop, and the Contact Us form

sourcesRead.contributes: goal, background (brandsList semantics, HTTP 200 + responseCode convention, Brands panel on /products, Contact Us page /contact_us, out of scope), AC table AC-1..AC-8

actors: shoppers browsing the catalogue by brand; partners reading brands through the public API; anyone using the Contact Us form (story.md#L17)
context: Brand data comes from the same catalogue as the products; GET /api/brandsList is public and on the same host as the shop (story.md#L21). The public catalogue API always answers HTTP 200 and reports the outcome in the responseCode field of its JSON body (story.md#L22). The Products page /products has a "Brands" panel in the left-hand sidebar; each brand links to a page listing that brand's products (story.md#L23). The Contact Us page /contact_us has a "Get In Touch" form, specified by the attached mock-up (story.md#L24, transcripts/contact-us-mockup.png.md#L3-L4).
outOfScope: the file attachment on the Contact Us form (story.md#L25, transcripts/contact-us-mockup.png.md#L9)

rules.text: GET /api/brandsList returns one entry per catalogue product: the entry id is the product id and brand is that product's brand. A brand appears once per product it has; the distinct brand names are our brands.
The public catalogue API, brandsList included, always answers with HTTP status 200 and reports the outcome in the responseCode field of its JSON body.
In the Brands panel of the Products page sidebar, each brand links to a page listing that brand's products.
Contact Us form: Email is mandatory (red asterisk); Name, Subject and Message are optional. The form must not be sent while a mandatory field is empty or the e-mail is not a valid address.

Submit flow: Submit → browser confirmation "Press OK to proceed!" → OK shows the green success banner above the form and replaces the form with a "Home" button; Cancel keeps the form as filled, no banner.
